sections.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.content: By using the Game News application, you accept these Terms of Service in full. If you do not agree, stop using the application and delete your account from the Settings screen.

sections.title: 2. Service provider
sections.content: Game News is operated by an independent developer. For any questions about the service or these terms: contact@fouzi-dev.fr.

sections.title: 3. Service description
sections.content: Game News aggregates and presents news from the Steam ecosystem for games you follow. The service is provided for information only; it may change or be discontinued at any time.

sections.title: 4. Use of the application
sections.content: You agree to use the application only for its intended purpose, not to harm its security or stability, and not to collect or exploit data about other users. Misuse may result in suspension or removal of access.

sections.title: 5. Accounts and Steam authentication
sections.content: Sign-in uses your Steam account. You remain responsible for the confidentiality of your Steam credentials and for actions taken through your account in the application. Valve Corporation is not a party to these terms.

sections.title: 6. Notifications and content
sections.content: Notifications and content come from public sources or Steam-related information. Accuracy, completeness, and availability are not guaranteed. Game News is not liable for third-party content (including Valve or game publishers).

sections.title: 7. Service availability
sections.content: We aim for continuous availability but make no warranty of uninterrupted service. Outages may occur (maintenance, updates, incidents, force majeure).

sections.title: 8. Intellectual property
sections.content: Elements specific to Game News (interface, in-app text excluding third-party content, the Game News name where applicable) remain the property of the publisher. Steam, Valve, and related assets are the property of Valve Corporation.

sections.title: 9. Limitation of liability
sections.content: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Game News is provided "as is". Where liability is established, it shall not exceed what is typically foreseeable for a free or low-cost app; indirect damages or data loss attributable to third parties or your equipment are excluded except where mandatory law provides otherwise.

sections.title: 10. Governing law and disputes
sections.content: These terms are governed by French law. Failing an amicable settlement, French courts shall have jurisdiction, without prejudice to mandatory consumer rules of the European Union (including, where the law so requires, the courts of your habitual residence).

sections.title: 11. Changes to the terms
sections.content: These terms may be updated. The binding version is the one displayed in the application with its update date. If you continue to use Game News after a new version is published, you are deemed to accept the changes unless the law requires separate consent.

sections.title: 12. Contact
sections.content: Questions about these Terms of Service: contact@fouzi-dev.fr.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.content: The controller of personal data processed through Game News is the publisher of the application, reachable at: contact@fouzi-dev.fr.

sections.title: 2. Data we process
sections.content: We process, where necessary for the service: your Steam ID; library and playtime data synced from Steam; recently active games; your wishlist; games you follow; news items you may bookmark as favorites; the display language you choose in the app; notification and follow settings (news alerts, library/wishlist follow modes, confirmation preferences); push notification tokens and related technical identifiers (FCM), with your device platform; limited technical logs (security, diagnostics, service availability).

sections.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases
sections.content: Providing the account and service (performance of these terms / pre-contractual measures): Steam sync, news display, managing followed games. Push notifications: where required by law, your consent or explicit activation in system and app settings; otherwise, limited legitimate interest strictly for messages related to the service you requested. Security, abuse prevention, and reliability: legitimate interest. Legal obligations where applicable: legal obligation. We do not sell data or carry out advertising profiling.

sections.title: 4. Recipients, processors, and transfers
sections.content: Data is hosted and processed on the publisher's infrastructure and that of technical providers. Push delivery uses Google Firebase Cloud Messaging (Google LLC / Google group companies), which may process technical data in the United States or other countries; where applicable, transfers rely on GDPR safeguards (including the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses) and Google's privacy policy. The service also relies on official Steam / Valve APIs under their applicable policies. Other processors (hosting, email) may act on the controller's instructions.

sections.title: 5. Retention
sections.content: Account and preference data are kept while your account is active; they are deleted or anonymised within a reasonable period after you delete your account in the app, unless a legal retention obligation applies. Technical logs are kept for a limited period strictly necessary for security and diagnostics (typically a few months, unless a prolonged incident requires longer retention). Invalid notification tokens are removed or replaced on subsequent connections.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.content: Under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and French law, you have, subject to conditions and legal exceptions, the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and data portability (where applicable). You may lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority; in France, the CNIL (www.cnil.fr). To exercise your rights: contact@fouzi-dev.fr; proof of identity may be requested if there is reasonable doubt.

sections.title: 7. Security
sections.content: Appropriate technical and organisational measures protect your data. No processing is entirely risk-free; if an incident materially affects your data, notification may be given as required by law.

sections.title: 8. Cookies, tracking, and ads
sections.content: The mobile app does not use web cookies. No third-party advertising trackers are integrated for targeting. A local cache may be used solely to improve display performance on your device.

sections.title: 9. Minors
sections.content: The service is intended for users able to contract with Steam and use the application. If you believe a minor has provided data without authority, contact us so we can take appropriate steps.

sections.title: 10. Changes to this policy
sections.content: This policy may be updated; the last revision date appears at the top of this document in the application. Please review it periodically.

sections.title: 11. Contact
sections.content: Questions about this policy or your personal data: contact@fouzi-dev.fr.
